decision.observation: Microbe Musher status panel open. STATUS: Under Construction. INFO: 'Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.' Options panel says 'No Configuration — There is no configuration available for this object' because it is still being built. Requirements: Power 240 W, Duplicant operation. 'Cancel Build' button at bottom. CO2 at cursor tile: 72.7 g Unbreathable. Idleness: 1. Cycle 2, food 15,704 kcal.
decision.hypothesis: Recipes cannot be queued until construction finishes. The Errands tab may show why construction is slow — clicking 'Errands' will show assigned dupes and progress. Alternatively, closing the panel and waiting will let construction finish naturally.
decision.memory: Musher cannot have recipes set while 'Under Construction'. 'No Configuration' message confirms this. After it completes, the Config tab will allow recipe queueing. Errands tab at (1140, 241) may show construction assignment. CO2 pooling at 72.7 g on the ledge near the Musher. Idleness: 1 means one dupe has no errand — may explain slow construction if only 1 dupe is building.
